description: This file implements minimal ASN.1, DER serialization, including classes for various ASN.1 data types and functions for encoding objects into DER format.

classes.name: Raw
classes.description: Contains raw DER encoded bytes used verbatim

classes.name: Explicit
classes.description: Prepends an explicit ASN.1 tag to a child object

classes.name: SEQUENCE
classes.description: Represents ASN.1 SEQUENCE of child objects

classes.name: SET
classes.description: Represents ASN.1 SET of child objects

methods.name: ToDER
methods.description: Converts an object into DER encoding

methods.name: TagAndLength
methods.description: Creates DER encoding for a tag and length

methods.name: TagAndData
methods.description: Creates DER encoding for a tag and data
